# Gil Ventures (Gil Marketing)

> Gil Ventures helps DTC and Shopify brands grow with ad creative and ad management, plus email and landing pages.

The public site is https://www.gil.marketing/. Founder: Brandon Gil (brandon@gil.marketing). Brands I've operated did $17M+ in revenue at a 5.5x blended ROAS.

## Blog

Notes on marketing, growth, brand, and the work of building a company — ads, content, AI, and whatever the business actually needs.

- [I wouldn't start with ads. I'd fix what happens after the click.](https://www.gil.marketing/blog/2026-11-20-after-the-click/): Ads buy attention. They don't fix a fuzzy offer, a mismatched page, or a missing follow-up. The four things to get straight before buying more traffic.
- [The six steps I still use — and the order I won't skip.](https://www.gil.marketing/blog/2026-11-20-six-steps/): A way of working written down in 2018 and still used. Listen first, then do the work in order.
